items.stem: Retrieval returns no passage relevant to the user's question. What should the answer be?

options.text: A statement that no supporting evidence was found
options.rationale: Correct: with no evidence, the honest answer is that none was found.

options.text: A confident answer from Claude's general knowledge
options.rationale: An ungrounded answer defeats the purpose of evidence-based search.

options.text: The highest-scoring passage even if irrelevant
options.rationale: An irrelevant passage does not support an answer.

options.text: A paraphrase of the question as the answer
options.rationale: Restating the question is not an answer.

items.explanation: Correct: with no evidence, the honest answer is that none was found.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO indexing choices support accurate citations? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Chunks sized to return coherent, citable passages
options.rationale: Correct: well-sized chunks let the system point to a meaningful span.

options.text: Source metadata attached to every chunk
options.rationale: Correct: metadata is what lets an answer cite the exact source.

options.text: Discarding document structure to simplify the index
options.rationale: Losing structure makes passages harder to cite accurately.

options.text: One giant chunk per document for completeness
options.rationale: An oversized chunk cannot pinpoint the supporting text.

items.explanation: Correct: well-sized chunks let the system point to a meaningful span.

items.stem: A query's top vector match has a very low relevance score. How should it be handled?

options.text: Apply a relevance threshold and treat it as no match
options.rationale: Correct: a weak match should not be presented as supporting evidence.

options.text: Return it anyway because it is the top result
options.rationale: Being top-ranked does not make a weak match relevant.

options.text: Lower the threshold until something is returned
options.rationale: Forcing a return produces unsupported answers.

options.text: Return all passages regardless of score
options.rationale: Returning everything buries any genuine evidence in noise.

items.explanation: Correct: a weak match should not be presented as supporting evidence.
